{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "A wool-blend coat, straight cut, hip-length, charcoal gray with hex code #36454F, heavy twill fabric.
Tucked in a merino cashmere sweater crewneck, boat neck, cropped length, heathered slate blue with hex code #5D7085, soft knit fabric.
Tailored wool trousers, wide-leg cut, full-length, deep navy with hex code #1A237E, fine worsted wool fabric.
Black leather loafers, classic slip-on shape, ankle height, matte black with hex code #0F1419, smooth calfskin fabric.

This outfit works because the charcoal coat and dark navy trousers provide a professional shield against the frosty minus-ten-degree snow while keeping you warm during your twenty-minute walk. The cropped slate sweater breaks up the darker blocks of color to prevent the look from feeling too heavy for a business meeting. Leather loafers offer practical traction on salted roads without the formality restriction of pumps, balancing comfort with neat casual elegance."}
